replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
There was probably another player in the game. If it gave you a message in chat saying that your team won, you would've been put into creative mode, and could fly around.
If you were still in survival mode and there was no message saying "Blue Team has won!" (Blue was an example), that means that you were not the last player alive.
